subject: pharmacology
title: Bone, calcium and hypercalcaemia drugs

steps.tx: **Bisphosphonates** (alendronate weekly oral, zoledronate yearly IV; osteoclast apoptosis) demand **upright fasting rules** (full glass, 30 to 60 minutes upright, oesophagitis otherwise) with calcium and vitamin D replete; harms (**osteonecrosis of jaw** with dental work, **atypical femoral fractures** with prodromal thigh pain, ocular inflammation) gate drug holidays after 5 years oral or 3 IV. Hypercalcaemia of malignancy (hydration first, then zoledronate, calcitonin bridging days) responds in days.
steps.say: Weekly bone pills stand upright fasting or burn gullet. Jaw rot with thigh ache on years of therapy warns.

steps.tx: **Denosumab** (RANKL antibody, 6 monthly, no renal dose cut suiting CKD) risks **rebound vertebral fractures on stopping** (transition to bisphosphonate mandatory) with hypocalcaemia and jaw necrosis shared; **teriparatide** (PTH anabolic, 2 year lifetime max, osteosarcoma rat caution, hypercalcaemia) builds in severe osteoporosis. **Raloxifene** (SERM: spine protection with breast cancer down, clots up, hot flushes) suits younger postmenopausal; calcitonin (nasal, modest, analgesic vertebral) niches. DEXA with FRAX starts and monitors.
steps.say: Stopping denosumab fractures spines: transition to bisphosphonate. Teriparatide builds two years max.

steps.tx: **Hypercalcaemia** (stones, bones, groans, psychiatric overtones: polyuria, confusion, constipation, QT short) is lowered by **saline diuresis first** (loop diuretics after rehydration, never before), **bisphosphonates** (days), **calcitonin** (hours bridge), **steroids** (granuloma, lymphoma vitamin D driven), **denosumab** (refractory malignancy), dialysis failing kidneys. Malignancy (PTHrP, lytic) versus primary hyperparathyroidism (surgical adenoma, familial MEN1) versus granuloma (high calcitriol) sort cause; PTH intact guides.
steps.say: Confused constipated polyuric high calcium is malignancy until PTH sorts: saline first, then zoledronate. Steroids calm granuloma calcium.

vis.caption: Hypercalcaemia: symptoms and initial management

steps.tx: **Cinacalcet** (calcimimetic, secondary hyperparathyroidism dialysis and parathyroid carcinoma, hypocalcaemia watched) with paricalcitol balances CKD bone; **calcium with vitamin D** (dietary first, carbonate with meals, citrate achlorhydria, hypercalciuria stones caution) underpins all therapy. Hypocalcaemia (Chvostek and Trousseau, prolonged QT, IV calcium gluconate with cardiac monitoring, magnesium corrected first) mirrors management. Thiazides retain calcium usefully; loop diuretics waste.
steps.say: Dialysis PTH soaring is secondary hyperpara: cinacalcet. Perioral tingling post thyroidectomy is hypo: calcium.
